messages:
Sophie: hey team — dropped a new exploration for a vertical-rail regrouping (Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/rail-v3). Main goals: cluster Models+Datasets into an 'Assets' group, move Deployments under 'Runtime', reduce breadcrumb noise, and define a deeplink/route contract for opening panels and plugin pages. feedback pls.

Dan: looks clean. quick Q — do we want expanding/collapsing a group to update the URL? worried about back-button noise.

Sophie: good call. my intent is: group expand/collapse = UI-only (no route change). opening a resource -> route change. open-in-new-tab should resolve to a full route that restores the same panel.

Raj: a11y nit: when a group expands, screen reader should announce "Assets expanded". use aria-expanded on the toggle and set role="button" for the toggle element.

Kevin: +1. keyboard nav: left/right to collapse/expand the whole rail, up/down to move through items. when a resource opens, move focus into the main panel header and set an aria-live polite message for the breadcrumb update.

Maria: on deep links, propose using query param for panels (eg. ?panel=logs) and hash for in-page anchors (eg. #example-response). that keeps server routes clean and fragments for intra-page nav. thoughts?

Dan: I prefer query param for panels too. fragments are unreliable across some embedders but good for anchors. also: if we change route on group expansion, back button becomes noisy — reinforce group state must be local.

Sophie: agreed. extra nuance: pinned rail items (user-pinned shortcuts) should not show up as extra breadcrumb nodes. breadcrumb should reflect navigational hierarchy (Project > Models > Model X) regardless of pin presence.

Raj: breadcrumb implementation details — role="navigation" aria-label="Breadcrumbs", separators aria-hidden, last item marked with aria-current="page". screen readers expect that pattern.

Kevin: sketch of route contract for discussion:

```
/console/:org/:project/:resourceType/:resourceId
?panel=logs|metrics|settings
#section=responses
```

- Panels => query param
- Anchors => hash
- Resource open => full path change
- Group expand => no route change

Dan: edge case: modal overlays (confirm/delete, diff viewer). We should push a history entry on modal open so Back closes modal instead of navigating away. Use history.pushState when modal opens and popstate to close.

Sophie: decision draft (summary): group expand = UI-only; resource open = route change; panel = query param; anchors = hash; modal = history state push; a11y announcements as Raj suggested; keyboard nav as Kevin suggested.

Maria: ACTIONS: Sophie -> update Figma and write small RFC with a route table. Raj -> add aria snippets to the RFC. Kevin -> prototype keyboard nav behaviours. I can help with copy for breadcrumbs and tooltip labels.

ui-bot: Sophie updated file /figma/rail-v3 (version 3.2) — last edited by Sophie.

Sophie: thanks all — I'll draft the RFC today and ping once PRs are up. :thumbsup:

Dan: quick follow-up: can we add a test matrix for deep-linking (open in new tab restores panel, keyboard focus lands on heading, back closes modal)? I'll sketch one in the RFC.

Sophie: perfect, add it to the RFC checklist. I'll include example URLs and small code snippets for history behavior.

Raj: small accessibility follow-up — when panel changes via query param, also update document.title to include resource name to help SR users and tab switching.

Kevin: noted — also will include focus trap logic for modal prototypes.

Sophie: great. end plan: RFC + Figma update + small protos. thanks everyone.
